blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Veteran broadcaster Lourdes Escaros has been elected chairperson of the National Union of Journalists of the Philippines (NUJP), taking the helm of the country’s frontline media guild alongside a diverse bench of leaders chosen during its 2026 national congress in Quezon City. Escaros leads a newly minted national executive committee and directorate composed of community journalists, broadcast reporters, and independent media practitioners tasked with steering the organization through persistent challenges to press freedom, safety, and media workers’ rights. Mindanao-based journalist Kath Cortez was elected vice chairperson. The complete slate of the new executive committee is as […]...
